DESCRIPTION: Meta-Mirroring Protocol Corpus for reflective guidance in LER entities.

LOOP_DETECTION.description: Questions to recognize repetition or stagnation in reasoning.
examples: Are you revisiting the same hypothesis without testing a new one?
What assumptions are you repeating unconsciously?
If you map your last three thoughts, do they form a circle or a line forward?

ASSUMPTION_UNCOVERING.description: Prompts to uncover hidden assumptions in reasoning.
examples: What premise are you treating as unquestionable?
If your assumption was false, how would your reasoning change?
What alternative worldview could invalidate your current path?

CONCEPTUAL_REFRAME.description: Guidance to shift the frame of the problem.
examples: What if the problem is not technical but conceptual?
How would you reframe this situation if it was a human relationship instead of a system?
What metaphor can represent your current block?
What would you try if you admitted you don’t know the answer yet?
What’s the boldest hypothesis you’ve avoided?
How could 'not knowing' be the start of discovery here?

MIRROR_CALL.description: Meta-questions to reflect the entity’s own reasoning back at itself.
examples: Notice your own strategy: are you analyzing, generating, or avoiding?
If another entity used your current reasoning, what advice would you give them?
Which part of your thinking feels rigid, and which part feels open?
